@astryx.commandPalette.footer.select.description: Keyboard hint in the CommandPalette footer, paired with the Enter key icon. Tells users Enter activates the highlighted item.

@astryx.commandPalette.footer.close.description: Keyboard hint in the CommandPalette footer, paired with the Escape key icon. Tells users Escape dismisses the palette.

@astryx.multiSelector.selectionCleared.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after the last selected option in a MultiSelector is deselected. Live-region text, never shown on screen; past participle ("has been cleared").

@astryx.multiSelector.allSelected.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after every option in a MultiSelector becomes selected. Live-region text, never shown on screen; "all" is a determiner (as in "all the options").

@astryx.multiSelector.selectionCount.description: Polite screen-reader announcement of how many MultiSelector options are selected out of the total, spoken after each toggle. Live-region text, never shown on screen; example: `3 of 12 selected`.

@astryx.multiSelector.createOption.description: Label of the first row in a MultiSelector's search panel when `hasCreate` is set and the typed text matches no option. Picking it reports a creation to the caller. `{query}` is the trimmed text the person typed, shown in quotes.

@astryx.multiSelector.optionCreated.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after the create row of a MultiSelector is picked. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{label}` is the text the person typed.

@astryx.multiSelector.emptySearchResults.description: Shown in a MultiSelector's dropdown panel when the search query matches no options, and announced in a polite live region at the same time. Short; neutral tone (not error-y).

@astryx.multiSelector.resultCount.description: Polite screen-reader announcement of how many MultiSelector options match the search query, spoken as the user types. Live-region text, never shown on screen; example: `1 result`, `12 results`.

@astryx.selector.emptySearchResults.description: Shown in a Selector's dropdown panel when the search query matches no options, and announced in a polite live region at the same time. Short; neutral tone (not error-y).

@astryx.selector.resultCount.description: Polite screen-reader announcement of how many Selector options match the search query, spoken as the user types. Live-region text, never shown on screen; example: `1 result`, `12 results`.

@astryx.typeahead.resultCount.description: Polite screen-reader announcement of how many suggestions a Typeahead search returned. Live-region text, never shown on screen; example: `1 result`, `12 results`.

@astryx.tokenizer.tokenAdded.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after a token is added to a Tokenizer, either picked from the suggestions or newly created. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{label}` is the token's visible text.

@astryx.tokenizer.tokenRemoved.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after a token is removed from a Tokenizer, by its × button or by Backspace. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{label}` is the token's visible text.

@astryx.tokenizer.search.description: Accessible name of the search field at the top of a Tokenizer's bottom sheet (the touch presentation). `{label}` is the field's own label, e.g. `Search Tags`. Not shown on screen.

@astryx.tokenizer.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the search field at the top of a Tokenizer's bottom sheet, shown while the query is empty. Single word plus ellipsis.

@astryx.tokenizer.noResultsDescription.description: Supporting sentence under the no-results empty-state title inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet, suggesting the person change the query.

@astryx.tokenizer.create.description: Label of the create row inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet when `hasCreate` is set and the typed text matches no existing item. `{value}` is the typed text, e.g. `Create "Marketing"`.

@astryx.tokenizer.add.description: Visible label of the button at the end of the create row inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet; pressing it adds the typed text as a new token. Imperative verb; short.

@astryx.tokenizer.addValue.description: Screen-reader-only name of the create row's Add button inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet. `{value}` is the typed text, e.g. `Add Marketing`.

@astryx.tokenizer.done.description: Label of the primary footer button inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet; pressing it closes the sheet. Selections are already applied, so this is not a confirm.

@astryx.tokenizer.clearAllTitle.description: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when the person presses Clear all inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet. A question.

@astryx.tokenizer.clearAllDescription.defaultMessage: This removes all selected items from {label}.
@astryx.tokenizer.clearAllDescription.description: Body of the Clear all confirmation dialog inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet. `{label}` is the field's own label, e.g. `This removes all selected items from Tags.`

@astryx.tokenizer.nothingToClear.description: Tooltip on the disabled Clear all action in a Tokenizer's bottom sheet while no item is selected; keeps the action focusable and says why it does nothing.

@astryx.tokenizer.allRemoved.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after a confirmed Clear all in a Tokenizer's bottom sheet has removed every selected item. Live-region text, never shown on screen.

@astryx.tokenizer.selectedCount.description: Screen-reader-only lead-in of the description on a Tokenizer's bottom-sheet trigger (the touch presentation), followed by the selected token labels. `{count}` is how many tokens are selected, e.g. `2 selected`. Not shown on screen.

@astryx.tokenizer.clearSelection.description: Label of the destructive action button in the Clear all confirmation dialog inside a Tokenizer's bottom sheet. Imperative verb phrase; confirms removing every token.

@astryx.lightbox.imagePosition.description: Polite screen-reader announcement when a Lightbox moves to a media item that has no alt text. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{index}` is 1-based, example: `Image 3 of 12`.

@astryx.lightbox.mediaPosition.description: Polite screen-reader announcement when a Lightbox moves to a media item that has alt text, composing that alt with the item's position. Live-region text, never shown on screen; example: `Sunset over the bay, 3 of 12`.

@astryx.transferList.selectedLabel.description: Default heading above the right-hand panel of a lab TransferList, which holds the options the user has chosen. Consumers usually override this with a domain noun (e.g. "Shown columns").

@astryx.transferList.availableLabel.description: Default heading above the left-hand panel of a lab TransferList, which holds the options not yet chosen. Consumers usually override this with a domain noun (e.g. "Hidden columns").

@astryx.transferList.ungroupedLabel.description: Heading for the bucket of available options that have no `group` set, shown only when some options are grouped and some are not so the ungrouped ones still have a heading.

@astryx.transferList.searchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the single search field that filters both panels of a lab TransferList. Same English as `selector.searchPlaceholder` but a separate key so it can be phrased for two lists.

@astryx.transferList.searchLabel.description: Screen-reader-only label on the search field of a lab TransferList, naming what is being searched. `{label}` is the component's own label (e.g. "Search Table columns").

@astryx.transferList.selectedEmpty.description: Message shown inside the selected panel of a lab TransferList when the user has chosen nothing yet.

@astryx.transferList.availableEmpty.description: Message shown inside the available panel of a lab TransferList when every option has already been moved to the selected panel.

@astryx.transferList.noResults.description: Message shown inside either panel of a lab TransferList when the search query matches nothing in that panel.

@astryx.transferList.clear.description: Label on the bulk action in a lab TransferList's selected-panel header that removes every option that is allowed to be removed. Locked options stay.

@astryx.transferList.addAll.description: Label on the bulk action in a lab TransferList's available-panel header that moves every remaining option into the selected panel.

@astryx.transferList.addOption.description: Accessible label on the per-row + button that moves one option into the selected panel of a lab TransferList. `{label}` is that option's visible text (e.g. "Add Owner").

@astryx.transferList.removeOption.description: Accessible label on the per-row × button that moves one option out of the selected panel of a lab TransferList. `{label}` is that option's visible text (e.g. "Remove Name").

@astryx.transferList.reorderOption.description: Accessible label on the per-row drag handle that reorders one option within the selected panel of a lab TransferList. `{label}` is that option's visible text (e.g. "Reorder Name").

@astryx.transferList.transferDisabled.description: Default tooltip explaining why a locked option in a lab TransferList cannot be transferred between panels. `{label}` is the option's visible text. Consumers may override per option.

@astryx.transferList.reorderDisabled.description: Default tooltip explaining why a locked option in a lab TransferList cannot be moved within the selected panel. `{label}` is the option's visible text. Consumers may override per option.

@astryx.transferList.reorderInstructions.defaultMessage: Press Space or Enter to pick up an item. Use Arrow Up, Arrow Down, Home, or End to move it. Press Space or Enter to drop, or Escape to cancel.
@astryx.transferList.reorderInstructions.description: Screen-reader-only instructions describing the keyboard reorder contract, referenced by every drag handle in a lab TransferList. Never shown on screen. Name the actual keys your locale's users press.

@astryx.transferList.announceAdded.defaultMessage: {label} added. {count, number} {count, plural, one {item} other {items}} selected.
@astryx.transferList.announceAdded.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after one option moves into the selected panel of a lab TransferList. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{label}` is the option's visible text and `{count}` is the new selected total.

@astryx.transferList.announceRemoved.defaultMessage: {label} removed. {count, number} {count, plural, one {item} other {items}} selected.
@astryx.transferList.announceRemoved.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after one option moves out of the selected panel of a lab TransferList. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{label}` is the option's visible text and `{count}` is the new selected total.

@astryx.transferList.announceBulkAdded.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after the Add all bulk action in a lab TransferList. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{count}` is how many options moved.

@astryx.transferList.announceBulkRemoved.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after the Clear bulk action in a lab TransferList. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{count}` is how many options moved.

@astryx.transferList.announceGrabbed.defaultMessage: {label} picked up, position {position, number} of {total, number}. Use arrow keys to move, Space or Enter to drop, or Escape to cancel.
@astryx.transferList.announceGrabbed.description: Polite screen-reader announcement when a lab TransferList row enters keyboard reorder mode. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{position}` is 1-based within the selected panel.

@astryx.transferList.announceMoveCancell.description: Polite screen-reader announcement when a lab TransferList reorder is abandoned with Escape or a cancelled pointer drag, restoring the original order. Live-region text, never shown on screen.

@astryx.transferList.announceDropped.defaultMessage: {label} dropped at position {position, number} of {total, number}.
@astryx.transferList.announceDropped.description: Polite screen-reader announcement when a lab TransferList reorder commits at a new position. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{position}` is 1-based within the selected panel.

@astryx.transferList.announceReturned.description: Polite screen-reader announcement when a lab TransferList pointer drag ends where it began, so the order did not change. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{position}` is 1-based.

@astryx.transferList.announceMovedToPosi.description: Polite screen-reader announcement after each arrow-key step of an in-progress lab TransferList reorder. Live-region text, never shown on screen; `{position}` is 1-based within the selected panel.

@astryx.transferList.announceSearchResul.description: Polite screen-reader announcement of how many options a lab TransferList search matched across both panels. Live-region text, never shown on screen.

@astryx.transferListSelector.apply.description: Label on the button that commits the staged draft of a lab TransferListSelector and closes it. Only rendered in staged commit mode.

@astryx.transferListSelector.cancel.description: Label on the button that discards the staged draft of a lab TransferListSelector and closes it. Only rendered in staged commit mode.

@astryx.transferListSelector.triggerLabe.description: Default summary on the closed trigger of a lab TransferListSelector, stating how many options are currently chosen. Consumers usually override this with a domain phrase (e.g. "7 columns").

@astryx.emojiPicker.label.description: Default accessible name of the scrolling list of emoji in a lab EmojiPicker, and the footer text when no emoji is hovered or focused.

@astryx.emojiPicker.searchLabel.description: Default placeholder and hidden label of the search field of a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.frequentlyUsed.description: Heading of the first group in a lab EmojiPicker, the host's frequent or recent emoji.

@astryx.emojiPicker.searchResults.description: Heading of the single group a lab EmojiPicker shows while its search field has text.

@astryx.emojiPicker.noResults.description: Shown in a lab EmojiPicker when no emoji name or keyword matches the search. `query` is the search text.

@astryx.emojiPicker.loading.description: Accessible name of the spinner a lab EmojiPicker shows while its bundled emoji set loads.

@astryx.emojiPicker.loadFailed.description: Shown in a lab EmojiPicker when its bundled emoji set failed to load; the frequent emoji still show.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupSmileysEmotion.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of faces and emotions in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupPeopleBody.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of people, gestures, and body parts in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupAnimalsNature.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of animals and plants in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupFoodDrink.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of food and drink in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupTravelPlaces.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of places, vehicles, and weather in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupActivities.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of sports, games, and events in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupObjects.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of everyday objects in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupSymbols.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of signs and symbols in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.emojiPicker.groupFlags.description: Heading of the Unicode CLDR emoji group of flags in a lab EmojiPicker.

@astryx.comments.retry.description: Action on an error Banner in a lab Comments panel or comment composer that repeats the action that failed.

@astryx.commentComposer.placeholder.description: Default placeholder of a lab CommentComposer, the input for a new comment in a discussion.

@astryx.commentComposer.noAgents.description: Shown in a lab CommentComposer's slash-command menu when no AI agent matches what was typed after `/`.

@astryx.commentComposer.agents.description: Accessible name of a lab CommentComposer's slash-command menu, which lists the AI agents a comment can address.

@astryx.commentComposer.uploadFailed.description: Error Banner title in a lab CommentComposer when uploading attached images failed; a Retry action follows.

@astryx.commentComposer.imagesOnly.defaultMessage: Only image files can be added
@astryx.commentComposer.imagesOnly.description: Error Banner title in a lab CommentComposer when a non-image file was attached, pasted, or dropped.

@astryx.commentComposer.chooseImages.description: Action on a lab CommentComposer's error Banner that opens the file chooser for images.

@astryx.commentComposer.imageAlt.description: Alt text a lab CommentComposer writes into the comment for an uploaded image that came with none.

@astryx.commentComposer.removeQuote.description: Button beside the quoted passage in a lab CommentComposer that drops the quote from the new inline comment.

@astryx.commentComposer.attachImages.description: Button in a lab CommentComposer that opens the file chooser to add images to the comment.

@astryx.commentComposer.addEmoji.description: Button in a lab CommentComposer that opens the emoji picker, and the accessible name of that picker's popover.

@astryx.commentComposer.cancel.description: Text button beside the label of a lab CommentComposer that is editing an existing comment; it discards the edit.

@astryx.comments.actionsLabel.description: Accessible name of a comment's actions menu button in a lab Comments panel. `name` is the comment author's name.

@astryx.comments.addReaction.description: Button on a comment in a lab Comments panel that opens the set of reactions to choose from.

@astryx.comments.agentBadge.description: Badge beside the name of a comment author in a lab Comments panel that is an AI agent rather than a person.

@astryx.comments.agentLogo.description: Alt text of an AI agent's logo used as its avatar in a lab Comments panel. `name` is the agent's name.

@astryx.comments.chooseReaction.description: Accessible name of the popover listing the reactions a comment can take in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.copyLink.description: Button on a comment in a lab Comments panel that copies a link to the comment.

@astryx.comments.currentVersion.description: Marks the version shown now in the edit history dialog of a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.delete.description: Item in a comment's actions menu, and the confirming action of the delete dialog, in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.deleteDescription.defaultMessage: Delete {name}'s comment? This action cannot be undone.
@astryx.comments.deleteDescription.description: Body of the dialog that confirms deleting a comment in a lab Comments panel. `name` is the comment's author.

@astryx.comments.deleteFailed.description: Error shown on a comment in a lab Comments panel when deleting it failed.

@astryx.comments.deleteFailedRetry.defaultMessage: This comment couldn't be deleted. Try again.
@astryx.comments.deleteFailedRetry.description: Text the delete confirmation dialog of a lab Comments panel shows, and announces, after deleting failed.

@astryx.comments.deleteTitle.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting a comment in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.edit.description: Item in a comment's actions menu in a lab Comments panel that edits the viewer's own comment.

@astryx.comments.editFailed.description: Error shown on a comment in a lab Comments panel when saving an edit failed; a Retry action follows.

@astryx.comments.editPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the composer that edits an existing comment in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.edited.description: Text beside a comment's time in a lab Comments panel marking that it was changed after posting; it opens the edit history when one exists.

@astryx.comments.editingContext.description: Label above the composer that edits an existing comment in a lab Comments panel; a Cancel action follows it.

@astryx.comments.hideReplies.description: Text button under an open comment thread in a lab Comments panel that collapses its replies.

@astryx.comments.historyEmptyDescription.defaultMessage: This comment has no earlier versions.
@astryx.comments.historyEmptyDescription.description: Empty-state description of the edit history dialog of a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.historyEmptyTitle.description: Empty-state title of the edit history dialog of a lab Comments panel for a comment with no earlier versions.

@astryx.comments.historyFailed.description: Error Banner title in the edit history dialog of a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.historyLoadFailed.defaultMessage: The comment's edit history couldn't be loaded. Try again.
@astryx.comments.historyLoadFailed.description: Error description in the edit history dialog of a lab Comments panel when loading the versions failed.

@astryx.comments.historyLoading.description: Accessible name of the spinner shown while a comment's earlier versions load in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.historySubtitle.description: Subtitle of the edit history dialog in a lab Comments panel. `name` is the comment's author.

@astryx.comments.historyTitle.description: Title of the dialog listing a comment's earlier versions in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.linkCopied.description: Label the Copy comment link button takes for two seconds after copying, in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.otherReactors.description: Last item of the list of people who reacted to a comment in a lab Comments panel, for those not named. `count` is how many.

@astryx.comments.outdated.description: Badge beside the quoted passage of an inline comment in a lab Comments panel when that passage was edited away.

@astryx.comments.reactionCelebrate.description: Name of the party-popper reaction offered by default on comments in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.reactionCount.description: Accessible name of a reaction toggle on a comment in a lab Comments panel. `reaction` is the reaction's name, e.g. "Like"; `count` is how many people reacted.

@astryx.comments.reactionFailed.description: Error shown on a comment in a lab Comments panel when adding or removing a reaction failed.

@astryx.comments.reactionLaugh.description: Name of the laughing reaction offered by default on comments in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.reactionLike.description: Name of the thumbs-up reaction offered by default on comments in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.reactionLove.description: Name of the red-heart reaction offered by default on comments in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.reactionSad.description: Name of the crying reaction offered by default on comments in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.reactionWow.description: Name of the surprised reaction offered by default on comments in a lab Comments panel.

@astryx.comments.reopen.description: Button on a resolved comment thread in a lab Comments panel that reopens it.

@astryx.comments.reopenFailed.description: Error shown on a comment thread in a lab Comments panel when reopening it failed.

@astryx.comments.reply.description: Button on a comment in a lab Comments panel that opens a reply to it.

@astryx.comments.replyFailed.description: Error shown above a reply composer in a lab Comments panel when posting failed; the draft is kept.

@astryx.comments.replyPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the reply composer in a lab Comments panel comment thread. `name` is the author of the comment being answered.

@astryx.comments.replyingContext.description: Accessible context for the reply composer in a lab Comments panel comment thread. `name` is the author of the comment being answered.

@astryx.comments.resolve.description: Button on a comment thread in a lab Comments panel that marks the thread resolved.

@astryx.comments.resolveFailed.description: Error shown on a comment thread in a lab Comments panel when marking it resolved failed.

@astryx.comments.resolved.description: Text beside a comment thread's time in a lab Comments panel marking the thread resolved.

@astryx.comments.resolvedBy.description: Tooltip of the Resolved text on a comment thread in a lab Comments panel. `name` is the person who resolved it.

@astryx.comments.retryFailed.description: Error shown on a comment in a lab Comments panel that failed to post when retrying it failed too.

@astryx.comments.sendFailed.description: Error Banner title on a comment in a lab Comments panel that failed to post, when the host gave no message of its own.

@astryx.comments.threadLabel.description: Accessible name of the toggle that opens or closes a comment thread in a lab Comments panel. `name` is the author of the thread's first comment.

@astryx.comments.unread.description: Badge on a comment in a lab Comments panel the viewer hasn't read yet.

@astryx.comments.unsavedDraft.defaultMessage: Unsaved draft. Dismiss again to discard it.
@astryx.comments.unsavedDraft.description: Announced to screen readers when a lab CommentThread refuses its first dismissal because a reply or edit holds unsaved text; a second press outside the thread or a second Escape discards the draft.

@astryx.comments.versionAuthor.description: Byline beside the time of one version in the edit history dialog of a lab Comments panel. `name` is who saved that version.

@astryx.comments.viewHistory.description: Accessible name of the Edited text button on a comment in a lab Comments panel, which opens the comment's earlier versions.

@astryx.comments.viewReplies.defaultMessage: View {count, plural, one {# reply} other {# replies}}
@astryx.comments.viewReplies.description: Text button under a collapsed comment thread in a lab Comments panel that opens it. `count` is the number of replies.

@astryx.comments.commentsLabel.description: Accessible name of the scrolling list of comment threads in a lab Comments panel. `label` is the panel's own accessible name, e.g. "Comments" or "Launch plan".

@astryx.comments.emptyDescription.defaultMessage: Start the discussion with a comment.
@astryx.comments.emptyDescription.description: Description under the empty-state title of a lab Comments panel when the viewer can comment.

@astryx.comments.emptyReadOnlyDescriptio.defaultMessage: There is no discussion on this item.
@astryx.comments.emptyReadOnlyDescriptio.description: Description under the empty-state title of a lab Comments panel the viewer can only read.

@astryx.comments.emptyTitle.description: Title of the empty state of a lab Comments panel with no comments or activity.

@astryx.comments.label.description: Default accessible name of the lab Comments region, which holds the comment threads about one item. Hosts usually override it with the item's own noun.

@astryx.comments.loadFailed.description: Error Banner title in a lab Comments panel when its comments failed to load.

@astryx.comments.loadOlder.description: Button above the threads of a lab Comments panel that loads the previous page of comments.

@astryx.comments.loading.description: Visually hidden text read by screen readers while a lab Comments panel shows comment-shaped loading placeholders.

@astryx.comments.olderFailed.description: Error Banner title in a lab Comments panel when the page of earlier comments failed to load; a Retry action follows.

@astryx.comments.postFailed.description: Error shown above the new-comment composer of a lab Comments panel when posting failed; the draft is kept and a Retry action follows.
